text:
Alana: opened a small PR to harmonize the audit-export examples with SOC2-friendly wording. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/999
Mara: thanks — is this just wording or are we changing example outputs too?
Alana: mainly wording + one tiny change: show `pseudonymized_user_id` field in examples instead of plain `user_id`. keeps reviewers happy.
Mara: can you paste the new curl + py snippets here? quick check before i loop in legal.
Alana: sure:
```bash
curl -X POST \\\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\
  -d '{\"tenant_id\":\"acme-123\",\"pseudonymize\":true,\"from\":\"2025-03-01\",\"to\":\"2025-03-31\"}' \\\
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export
```
```py
from redwood import AuditClient
import os
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.export(tenant_id='acme-123', pseudonymize=True, range=(\"2025-03-01\",\"2025-03-31\"))
```
Alana: example export JSON in the doc shows `pseudonymized_user_id`, `event_timestamp`, `action`, `resource_type`.
Mara: ok. pinging @legal-ops for SOC2 phrasing on pseudonymization. also add a small line that export honors tenant TTLs unless a legal hold is applied.
legal-ops: quick read — prefer the language: \"Identifiers are pseudonymized (irreversible hash). Timestamps and audit metadata are preserved for evidentiary purposes.\" also suggest we clarify \"tenant (customer-owned namespace)\" once.
Alana: updated wording accordingly, and added a short bullet listing pseudonymized fields: `user_id`, `email`, `session_id`.
devex-bot: Docs PR checklist: add CODEOWNERS, add snippet unit test, update changelog.
Mara: i'll review the final PR later today. if legal signs off we can merge after one more devex review. :thumbsup:
